steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: I prepared a gift for you, {@nickname}.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: What do you hear?
This is...

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Do you remember? This is the polarization formed when AMa-10 was born. You said you found a rhythm within its waveform. Of course, I added a little personal touch.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: I adjusted the direction of the planetary track's array to capture different echoes. The harmony is derived from the lingering neutrinos of extinguishing stars. As for the orchestrator, I used the gravitational folds left behind when the ship sailed through the stargate.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Oh... I knew you'd like it, {@nickname}.
The universe's singing... Even at this moment, it's still as touching as ever.
But this violates the norms we set ourselves, Priestess. These facilities should've kept operating on the preset path.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: The stars are losing their color. This world no longer has norms, doesn't it?

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: This place will fall silent soon, almost like we've never been here.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: Come walk with me, before the silence comes.

steps.name: Priestess
steps.text: I hope... we'll get to see this world's future with our own eyes together, {@nickname}.

a.text: 'We will... I will wait for you in that world.'

steps.text: Rhodes Island of Babel, Kazdel

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Phew! Finally done retrofitting the electrical wiring. Now we're gonna be able to withstand any impact... I think.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: How dare Kal'tsit make me work forty-eight hours nonstop... Once all this is over, I'm gonna tell Her Highness on her!

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Confirmed within the landship's communications range. Signal's clear. The mini bases you hid around are great, Closure.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Of course! Not even Her Highness has seen anything this handy!

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Is their so-called research finished?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: The energy surge caused by the last couple rounds almost got Rhodes Island to stall. I'm still reinforcing the landship for the next impact.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: You know how much I racked my brains to cover up the landship's movement? Like, what if the Military Commission's spies caught wind—

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Relax. I've already eliminated all our targets nearby. Just focus on your preparations.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Scout, report.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: The infiltration mission is complete. I'm sending the intel back to Babel.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: What's the situation inside the city?

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Not much has changed over the past few years. Not many Catastrophes. Very little movement.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Our situation's not very optimistic, actually. If the Military Commission continues to shrink our strategic space—

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Let's trust Her Highness and Dr. Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: You're right... They've spent so much time preparing for today's experiment just to turn the tide.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Right, Scout, have you gotten your hands on the equipment I was keeping at my place?

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: I've already entrusted it to a Messenger to take to Babel.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Awesome. With the secret weapon Kal'tsit and I knocked out together, we'll definitely crack that weird control system on the ship.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: I'll rendezvous with the Messenger and confirm the package's risk level before bringing it to the landship.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: We have been investigating the agent behind our missing engineer too. The threat against the landship hasn't been fully eliminated yet.

steps.name: Odda
steps.text: Closure, I brought you even more materials, just as you asked. They're so heavy!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Thanks, Odda! Hm... Looks like now I can make more safety equipment for Her Highness and Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: And I should install an extra line for backup. Hope there won't be any unexpected surprises this time...

steps.name: Odda
steps.text: Do you need any help, Closure?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Oh. You should hurry and evacuate to a safe zone with everybody else. The next wave of impacts... is probably gonna be in thirty minutes.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Now everything's all ready.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Hm... I'm kinda curious... Just what kind of secret experiments are Kal'tsit and Her Highness running? They even need to mod the energy and defense modules, not to mention those weird tests...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: There is no one with a better understanding of Originium.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If you want to solve the suffering caused by Originium...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: There is no better candidate for the job.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: The news you bring is always so... surprising. Even for the King of Sarkaz...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Are those devices really still working...? Are you confident about the resurrection?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: The vast majority of lifeforms on Terra can't resist corrosion that spans such a long stretch of time.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The Terra we see today is no doubt a miracle, and so are you, Theresa.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But in the past, the whole solar system revolving around the sun was insignificant in their eyes.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: You seem a little tense... and also a little anxious and nervous.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Is there anything else that worries you?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...Yes.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But... I can't tell you.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: It's okay! Sorry, I shouldn't have distracted you. Focus. I can feel it.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: 'Kal'tsit...' You love this name, don't you?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I... I've forgotten almost everything else about those days.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But I still remember how, in that distant, distant past, somebody gave me this name—

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: 'Kal'tsit.'

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: That was the last time we ever met.

a.text: 'Kal'tsit. I do not have much time left.
'Search for traces of life. Search for hope and a future.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Then why hesitate?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I know what you mean. It's just...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...I've had a premonition... worry... or perhaps, a conjecture.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: At the starting point of this land, at a certain point in time when life had only started budding, something that can never be reversed happened here.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: And I don't know what it is.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: If it's someone that even Dr. Kal'tsit can put her full faith in, then I'm not one bit worried.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Besides, considering how cautious you are, the safety measures that you prepared well ahead of time have never allowed me to worry.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'm sorry to say this, Theresa.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This alone, no matter how many contingency measures I prepare, I still can't confidently say anything is conclusive.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Theresa, I can't guarantee that I will always make the most rational decision.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: And this time... I want to believe.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Then do what you want to. I'll be here, with you.
Kal'tsit's hand touches the door that has stood silently still for a cryptically long stretch of time.
A new wave of tremors reaches Rhodes Island.
The door loosens.

a.text: 'Originium will become the beacon, condensed by our civilization...
'If one day, other lifeforms in the universe lose their homeland and seek a way to resolve their plight,
'We once delivered a gift to those who came after us, before our annihilation—

steps.text: (Unknown language) This place...
(Unknown language) Is... it... time already?
Warning: Unknown power activated.
Warning: PRTS access detected...
Warning: PRTS access detect—
PRTS access reset complete. Administrator permissions confirmed.
All communication module channels open. Communications receiver module overclocking procedure completed.
Search: Preserver... No signal.
Search: Caerula Arbor... No signal.
Search: Celestial Fulcrum... No signal.
Search: (Unknown static noise)... No signal.
Search complete. No signal detected on any channel.
Would you like to retry—
(Unknown language) No... answer...
(Unknown language) Just... me...
(Unknown language) How long... has it been?
Searching progress logs...
Latest update: Four million, seven hundred fifty-five thousand, nine hundred and fifty-four days ago.
Abnormal vital signs detected. Loading restoration module.
Restoring—
(Unknown language) Did I... wake up too early... or... too late?
(Unknown language) What stage... has Originium reached?
Searching Originium inspection history data... No response.
Originium inspection module is disconnected.
(Unknown language) 'Terra...'
(Unknown language) Why save... all these... redundant information...
(Unknown language) This... isn't recorded in the database... A new language?
(Unknown language) A new civilization... is born...?
(Unknown language) It's... just... me... What about her...? Priestess? My...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Unknown language) I can answer your question. I saved those data in PRTS in advance.
(Unknown language) You...?
A hint of unfamiliarity, perplexity, and... vigilance flashed in the eyes of the person stuck in the past.
Kal'tsit senses it from the glare of the person in the sarcophagus.
Likewise, Theresa senses Kal'tsit's nervousness.
(Unknown language) Wait...
(Unknown language) You've changed a fair bit...
The person inside the sarcophagus feels like they have just woken up from a short dream.
The lifeform that bid them farewell prior to sleep is still here by their side.
(Unknown language) ...but you've never left.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Unknown language) No... From the moment I left this place until now, when I am standing here before you again—

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Unknown language) I have wandered for thousands of years.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Unknown language) However, I have never forgotten the question you left me—
Kal'tsit waits uneasily. She needs to make sure...
She needs to make sure that her hope has not gone through some kind of horrible change.
(Unknown language) That... was not... a question. That was... what I looked forward to...
(Unknown language) Then... Have you found the meaning of your life yet?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Unknown language) Discovering the meaning in the continuation of life... It's a path that I will have to keep walking.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Unknown language) You still remember...
(Unknown language) I still remember... To me, it was like yesterday when we said goodbye to each other, but it also seemed like an eternity...
(Unknown language) But to you...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Unknown language) There was never a moment when I forgot all you have done for me.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Unknown language) Aside from my life, you granted me one other thing that I found most precious—Freedom, Dr. {@nickname}.
(Unknown language) Please... just Doctor will do, Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: (Unknown language) Let me... get out first...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Unknown language) You are still very weak. I can help—

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: (Unknown language) No need...

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: (Unknown language) Kal'tsit, I still... have many questions.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: (Unknown language) What has become of Originium...? I couldn't find any records.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Unknown language) It still grows on the continent outside.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: (Unknown language) So I woke up too early.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: (Unknown language) You've suffered, Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: (Unknown language) I can tell from your eyes. You woke me up because you need my help?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Unknown language) Yes, we need your help.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: (Unknown language) I see. That 'devil'?

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: (Unknown language) I can see from your friend behind you that not only has Originium found an unexpected way to exist...

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: (Unknown language) She also possesses... yes, Civilight Eterna.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Unknown language) The course of this civilization is... very complicated.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: (Unknown language) What's her name...? Does their civilization have anything like that used to refer to individuals?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Theresa.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: The... re... sa...
The awakened one walks up to Theresa and holds out two arms, showing the palms of those hands.
Theresa extends her hands to lightly hold the hands of the one from the past.
The Doctor feels warmth.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Yes, Theresa.
This is the moment two civilizations make contact with one another, yet Theresa can see sadness in the eyes of this Doctor from eras long gone.
And she feels no warmth from the hands she is holding.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Originium... and you... together.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: You speak our language?

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: I... learned... from... records. Not... hard.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Unbelievable! I was thinking about learning your language. Kal'tsit said—

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: My world... is lost. Languages of the past... should stay in the past.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: I... am curious about your kind. You found... and even entered... Civilight Eterna.

spans.text: I... am curious about your kind. You found... and even entered...

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: I... want to... ask—

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Ask you everything about your... civilization.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: That's the only way... I can find traces of my world... the world of the past.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: ...I understand.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Hm, Doctor, Is that how you say it? Please forgive me. Keep holding my hands.

spans.text: , Is that how you say it? Please forgive me. Keep holding my hands.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I will show you—
The Doctor cannot help but be attracted to the eyes of this creature that looks like a devil.
Through her eyes, the one who lost a world sees—
Life.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Civilization is born from the instinct of living beings. It's survival of the fittest.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Natural selection. This is how the cycle of life is formed.

steps.name: Burdenbeast
steps.text: (Feeble wailing)
A burdenbeast accidentally fell beneath the ice pushes a small cub up from the water with its head.
The small burdenbeast staggers on the ice and walks toward the hunters who are waiting afar with their bait.

steps.name: Kjerag Hunter
steps.text: It's coming this way. Get ready.
The hunter grabs the starving burdenbeast cub before the ice cracks underneath them.

steps.name: Kjerag Hunter
steps.text: Good. At least we managed to save one.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Rebellion. Going against our survival instinct is the catalyst of our civilization's evolution.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: And curiosity... curiosity is what we burn our lives away for, the staircase that allow our civilization to proceed forward.
A pioneer chasing the stars is pushing forward with his fallen ally on his back.

steps.name: Weary Pioneer
steps.text: *pant*... *pant*... You dipshit... Why can't you keep at it for just one more day?!

steps.name: Weary Pioneer
steps.text: The newspapers already said that it was the crashed aircraft of the Wrights, not a shooting star! But you just had to get to the bottom of it!

steps.name: Weary Pioneer
steps.text: They were failures who crashed from the sky! What was there to risk your life for?

steps.name: Weary Pioneer
steps.text: Those rocks that fell onto the land? What did you want to prove to me?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I, too, once saw within the Black Crown the sun getting engulfed, with darkness shrouding the whole continent.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: But even in its darkest hour, there were still those who tried to light up the night.

steps.name: Curious Archosauria
steps.text: It's still black! The sun really is dead!

steps.name: Courageous Archosauria
steps.text: *sigh*... The sun's been dead for too long... We gotta save it! If the sun doesn't live, how are we going to hold our tail thickness contests?

steps.name: Curious Archosauria
steps.text: But how?

steps.name: Courageous Archosauria
steps.text: We climb the tallest mountain, and raise a torch up high to light it back up.

steps.name: Curious Archosauria
steps.text: What if our arms get tired?

steps.name: Courageous Archosauria
steps.text: Hm... then we'll build a statue of me, and my statue will hold the torch up instead.

steps.name: Curious Archosauria
steps.text: Good idea! We can build my statue next to yours to hold up another torch, too! Then, if your torch goes out, my torch can light yours!

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: With fire comes light, and it is light that guides us toward hope.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: And my kin see death as a different interpretation of hope.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: After your body's destruction, to become one with the city within the Soul Furnace's flames is an honor bestowed only on those who are most respected.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: They will grow as Originium crystals and become one with Kazdel.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: The newborn will grow among the fluttering dust, and continue their march forward with hardships in tow amid the chorus of the myriad souls.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Progress mixed with ignorance... The cycle continues and repeats over and over.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: So... beautiful.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: So... nostalgic.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Your kind... Terra seems to have gotten back on the right track... and achieving enlightenment.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: How is 'ignorance' defined, and how do we prove the progress of 'enlightenment?'

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: The way I see it, all of this is part of our civilization.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: But the things you showed me... Most of them are... extremely different compared to your race.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Conquerors and the conquered, both have been branded with inerasable marks by this land throughout the evolution of civilization...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: For the sake of survival, I believe that all discrepancies will be unified, and all clans will become one.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: In the future that I envision, all the many lands will become one.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: That's a stirring belief... It's admirable.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: I can feel that... you truly love this great land.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Be it discrimination, war, or disaster... The object of your love has long surpassed an individual or a clan.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: But if you... surpass the extremes of the civilization you belong to... no one will be able to comprehend your love.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: On the contrary... they will loathe you.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Do you understand what you will have to go through... to reach the future you strive for?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: If there is no choice but to walk that path, I will gladly do so.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Theresa. A Terran.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: No wonder Kal'tsit trusts you. She willingly took the risk to wake me in order to help you.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Right. When every era comes to an end, there are always those who try their hardest to change the tide in the final moments.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: But most of the time, their stories don't end well.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Nevertheless, there is no doubt that you have my admiration.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: After all, on a certain level, you are very similar to some people that I knew.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: I will never get to see them again...

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: ...Perhaps I'll need some more time to get my thoughts in order.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: But no matter. I think I should... listen to what you two have to say first.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: What do you need me to do?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Doctor, you need rest.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: I'm fine.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Kal'tsit. She's given me lots of surprises, but on top of that, she's given me even more challenges.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Sorry... I mean 'confusion'.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: I still don't have a very good grasp of the Sarkaz language.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: I saw a lot of unexpected things in her. Surely you did too.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I made enemies with her, came to know her, began to understand her wish, and finally admired her responsibility...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: That Black Crown shared with Theresa the long history and experience it bears, and she too slowly gained foresight that no other can attain.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I felt... perhaps this would be our best chance. With her, with Babel, and with Terra.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: 'With Terra.'

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: You, too, are part of 'this great land' now, Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I hope you will take this journey with us, too.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Right...

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: I envy you, and I trust you, Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: But I am just a researcher. Perhaps the help I can offer won't be as significant as you hoped.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Oripathy, Catastrophe... Disasters that we have no methods to resist have been bringing many hardships to these lands... yet Terra's technology is almost entirely built atop the foundation that is Originium.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Fighting over energy, the discrimination against the Infected, and the estrangement between war and races are all further tearing these lands apart...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: We tried, but our efforts yielded very little... That's because we know practically nothing about Originium. We know nothing about this great land.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: What happened to the sky and the ocean? Where did the ancient ruins come from? How exactly... were we born?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: We hope you'll be able to find answers for us.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Surely, Kal'tsit must already have shared some of those with you.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: As for Originium, I'm sorry to say that the person I am now can't give you a good answer. At the very least, not an answer to everything.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: When I woke up, I tried to access the logs tracking Originium's progress, but strangely, there was nothing.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: And this glimpse of Terra that you showed me has made me even more confused.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: The development of Originium... has taken a completely different turn from what I expected. I need some time.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: I need to explore and see this great land for myself, to understand how exactly Originium has influenced culture, life, and environment.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: This could take years, perhaps longer... And maybe, after an enormous amount of energy is expended, you will receive only a most disappointing answer.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: I once made a promise to somebody. Thinking about it now, perhaps all I ever left myself or her... was regret.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: That's why I won't make a promise lightly, Kal'tsit. Forgive me...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: In that case, we will wait.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No matter what your answer will be, Babel will last until the day of your return, Doctor.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: ...Thank you.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Well... sorry... but I'm a little hungry.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: PRTS showed me that the landship has a temporary cafeteria...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: That it does, but it might be a little messy there. How about I take you—

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Thank you, Theresa, but no.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: This place has a special meaning to me, too. Let me walk there, slowly, by myself...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Okay... Be careful, Doctor.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The awakening has given the Doctor a lot of pressure, but it would seem this one is quick to adapt, and much quicker than I expected.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The Doctor wants to learn all there is to learn about Terra.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: A quick learner too, it seems.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: If the children were like the Doctor, perhaps they would have the chance to master even more languages and travel to so many places across Terra.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Theresa, you should go back and look for the others. There should be plenty of Babel affairs that need the Chairman herself to...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Theresa?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Kal'tsit... there's something bothering me. Maybe I'm overthinking it, but I want to tell you.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: The Doctor seems to be very surprised by the look of Terra as it is today.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: You once told me that nobody has a better understanding of Originium than the Doctor. The same Doctor who said that the development of Originium... took a completely different turn from the expected.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Then what should Originium have been like? What should these lands have been like?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: ...What should the Sarkaz have been like?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Is the Doctor ready to depart?

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Right. The Doctor applied for a transport, some defensive weapons, and nothing else.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: The Doctor stated an intent to avoid combat zones.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Alright. We'll just abide the Doctor's wishes.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Your Highness, I would like to follow this Doctor of ours. Considering the background involved... I am worried.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Ascalon... have you ever left Kazdel?

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Left? If we count how I once chased a quarry and left the area when I was small, then I most certainly have.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: That doesn't count.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Go, follow and protect the Doctor, but do not interfere.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: I will keep a close eye—

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: No, Ascalon, calm down. I don't want you to keep an eye on anyone.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I want you to go out there and see how the people in other lands live. This is a great opportunity.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: How they live?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Outside our homeland, neither war nor suffering is part of people's daily lives. Food, fashion, arts, culture... We could have so much.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Many of us know this fact, but even more of us choose to ignore this fact, because most of the time we don't have the freedom to choose.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Don't give me that look, Ascalon. Listen to me.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: At first, you followed me because you opposed Theresis's measures, but what about after this division is over?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: What will you do then? What will be the next stop for the countless Sarkaz who share the same idea as you?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: That's why you need to take a break from the war, and see the sights beyond our homeland.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: See the life that we should have lived.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: If that is your wish.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: It is!

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Have a safe trip.
